method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Banking Act 1959, compilation register id C2026C00104, retrieved 13 October 2026, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C1959A00006.txt. The Banking Regulation 2016 is not deposited: the s 16AG limit (the lives use $250,000, an input value), the s 16AF clearance adjustment, the accounts prescribed for ss 5(4)(a), 5(7) and 16AH(5), and the s 69 variations are inputs.

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the depositor: s 5(1) account-holder and declared ADI; s 5(4)-(7) protected account; Division 2AA Financial Claims Scheme -- s 16AD (when the scheme can be switched on; irrevocable), s 16AF (balance plus accrued interest, clearance adjustment, equal shares of joint accounts), s 16AG (limit per account-holder per ADI, an input), s 16AH (ways of payment; account opened without consent; same-kind account), s 16AHA (statement within 14 days after the financial year), s 16AI (APRA substituted as creditor; residual claim), s 16AIC(3) (nil after a transferred liabilities determination); s 69 unclaimed moneys (7 years, children's account exclusion, handover to the Commonwealth, repayment with interest). Out: ss 16AE, 16AIA-16AIB, Subdivisions D-G, s 16AF(3), Corporations Act set-off, and the Act's prudential and supervisory machinery.
seat: the depositor (the account-holder; in the lives, Chloe, the child account holder)
lives: chloe c012 (2010-03-20): a children's savings account, her mother as signatory -- are her deposits protected?
